name: Agility drill
pattern: Quick footwork and changes of direction from a low athletic stance: shuffles, ladders, cone and dot drills.
setup: Athletic stance: feet a bit wider than the hips, knees and hips bent, chest up.
Weight on the balls of the feet.
Set cones or a ladder on a non-slip floor.

steps.text: Push off the outside foot to move sideways; do not cross your feet.
Bring the trailing foot in under you, stance stays low and wide.
To change direction, sink the hips, plant the outside foot and push back.

cues.cue: Stay low: hips back, knees bent, chest up.
cues.why: Lowering the centre of mass before a cut lets you brake and push off faster.

cues.cue: Knee over the toes on every plant; never let it cave in.
cues.why: Knee valgus on landing and cutting predicts ACL injury.

cues.cue: Slow down over a few short steps before a sharp turn.
cues.why: Braking on the steps before the final plant lowers knee load in sharp cuts.
Agility combines fast footwork with reading what is around you.

breathing: Breathe freely; each drill is short.

tempo.note: Work 5-20 s per drill at full speed with full rest; quality over fatigue.

mistakes.name: Knee caves in on the plant
mistakes.looks: The planted knee falls inside the foot.
mistakes.fix: Push the knee out over the second toe and sink the hips.

mistakes.name: Standing too tall
mistakes.why: Slower direction changes and stiffer, harder landings.

mistakes.name: Feet cross or click
mistakes.looks: Feet clip together or cross in a shuffle.
mistakes.fix: Keep the feet at least hip width apart.
mistakes.why: Easy to trip and lose balance.

safety: Warm up first; build from slow to full speed.
Use a non-slip surface and good shoes.

variants.change: Shuttle running forward, back and sideways: about 11.0 MET (02078).
Ladder, dot and shuffle footwork: same code, lower in practice when done at walking pace.

subtypes.name: Ladder and dot drills
subtypes.change: Small fast steps or two-foot hops into boxes; upright, heels off the floor.

subtypes.name: Cone, T, L and X drills
subtypes.change: Sprints between cones with a plant and turn at each; lean into the turn.

harder: high hurdle jump to sprint and cut

motion.basis: Cutting and braking principles from dossantos2018 and hewett2005; agility definition from sheppard2006. Shuffle angles are estimates.
